name: Nikova Raskol
summary: In Old Town, Nikova Raskol grieves for her murdered grandson. The elderly Stormwind townswoman seeks justice against the Defias Brotherhood rioters held in the Stockade.

sections.title: A Grandmother's Grief
sections.body: Nikova Raskol wanders Old Town, carrying the grief of a recent loss. Her beloved grandson, Mac, was slain by Defias Brotherhood brigands. While the kingdom faces treason on a grand scale, Nikova bears the private cost of the Brotherhood's lawless rampage.

sections.title: Vengeance in the Stockade
sections.body: Many criminals who wrecked havoc were captured and locked in the Stockade, but a violent inmate rebellion has seized the prison. The guards have failed to restore order, and Nikova turns to adventurers heading inside. She asks them to bring back red Defias bandanas as proof that her grandson's killers have faced retribution.

faq.answer: Nikova Raskol is an elderly Stormwind resident who walks Old Town's oval road. She mourns her grandson Mac, murdered by Defias thugs.

faq.q: What happened to her grandson Mac?
faq.answer: Mac was fourteen. When the army marched to the front, he took up arms as a guard in the Stockade, where the Defias are locked up. After he reprimanded prisoners for tearing their wool blankets into gang scarves, they stabbed him in the back.

faq.q: Why does she want red bandanas from the Stockade?
faq.answer: The red bandana marks the Defias Brotherhood. Nikova asks fighters entering the rebellious Stockade to bring back the neckerchiefs as proof that the criminals who took innocent lives have been dealt with.

faq.q: Where can Nikova Raskol be found?
faq.answer: Nikova paces along Old Town's main thoroughfare, near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and Stormwind City's training grounds.

angles.text: For Alliance champions in Stormwind, helping Nikova is a reminder that defending the kingdom means protecting ordinary townsfolk whose families have been torn apart by civil unrest.
